hawkish.title: Oct Core PCE 3.3% y/y & Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%
hawkish.summary: Sticky 3.3% core PCE (vs 3.2% est.) and 4.3% Q3 GDP reinforce December tightening.

data.actual: PCE +0.3% m/m (3.8% y/y), Core PCE +0.3% (3.3% y/y); Q3 GDP 4.3% ann.
data.forecast: Core PCE 3.2% y/y; Q3 GDP adv 3.4%
data.delta_label: +0.1pp core PCE surprise; +0.9pp GDP upward rev

hawkish.reason: Core PCE accelerated to 3.3% y/y alongside +0.7% personal income and an upward 4.3% Q3 GDP revision (final private sales +5.8%), leaving no disinflation buffer ahead of December 9.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp leg held 0.92/0.93 across the 13:30Z PCE & Q3 GDP releases (2,105 contracts in 13:35Z minute) and >25bp held 0.03/0.04 before easing to 0.02/0.03 by 22:06Z; Polymarket reached 96% hike on Nov 25.

hawkish.title: Oct FOMC 10-2 hold was 'close call'; minutes flag hikes
hawkish.summary: Two voters dissented for +25bp; minutes show 'almost all' back more hikes if inflation stalls.

data.actual: 10-2 hold (Cook, Hammack dissented +25bp); 'almost all' see further hikes appropriate

hawkish.reason: Consolidates the Oct 28 statement and Nov 18 minutes: holding barely prevailed as a 'close call', most saw broad-based inflation risks, and a couple floated >25bp.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec +25bp rose 0.79->0.81 on Oct 28 (76.9k contracts); >25bp leg rose 0.065->0.075 on Nov 18 minutes.

hawkish.title: Williams & Jefferson: inflation too high, further hikes needed
hawkish.summary: FOMC Vice Chair and Fed Vice Chair point to ~3.5% inflation and AI-led demand requiring action.

data.actual: Williams (Nov 23): PCE ~3.5%, 'still work to do'; Jefferson (Nov 13): inflation 'more important signal'
data.previous: Oct 28: both backed pause for more data

hawkish.reason: Consolidates key-principal remarks only (NY Fed Pres. Williams Nov 17/23, Vice Chair Jefferson Nov 13/19): both see strong growth and above-target inflation needing tighter policy while Williams pushed back against 'dramatic' 50bp moves.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi >25bp leg trimmed 0.055->0.045 on Williams Nov 17 'no dramatic action' remarks while 25bp stayed 0.90-0.93.

hawkish.title: Oct CPI +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% a third straight month
hawkish.summary: Three consecutive 0.3% monthly core gains beat consensus and keep underlying inflation stalled.
hawkish.reason: Three straight 0.3% monthly core CPI prints confirmed sticky price momentum ahead of November PCE and December FOMC.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi >25bp leg jumped 0.055->0.105 at 08:30 ET release on 345,470 contracts.

hawkish.title: Oct payrolls +165k (4.1% u-rate) & retail control +0.6%
hawkish.summary: Rebounding hiring and +0.6% control retail sales remove labour-slack cover for holding.

data.actual: +165k payrolls, u3 4.1%, AHE +0.4% m/m; Oct control retail +0.6% (Nov 17 Census)

hawkish.reason: Consolidates real-activity beats: +165k payrolls with +84k prior revisions and strong Oct retail control (+0.6%) show demand absorbing 3.75-4.00% rates.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp leg jumped 0.645->0.785 (+14.0pp) on 68,547 contracts at Nov 6 payrolls release.

dovish.title: Chair Warsh stays non-committal on Dec; cites AI productivity
dovish.summary: Chair declined December forward guidance and focused on AI productivity rather than rate size.

data.actual: Oct 28: 'don't believe in prejudging meetings'; Nov 16: AI productivity remarks, no Dec guidance

dovish.reason: Consolidates Chair Warsh's Oct 28 presser and Nov 16 SF Fed speech: refusing to pre-commit and emphasizing AI productivity supply gains marginally tempers size expectations.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi >25bp leg eased 0.085->0.075 in the 12:00 ET Nov 16 hour (113,079 contracts) while 25bp stayed 0.88/0.89.

dovish.title: Real consumer spending flat across Sep–Oct (-$5.8B in Oct)
dovish.summary: Real PCE edged down in October (-$5.8B) after stalling in September, limiting 50bp tail risk.

data.actual: Oct real PCE -$5.8B (<-0.1% m/m); Sep real PCE <+0.1%

dovish.reason: High prices continue eroding real consumption volume even as nominal income rises, supporting a measured 25bp step over aggressive tightening.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi >25bp leg eased to 0.02/0.03 (mid 0.025) on Nov 25.

hawkish.title: Oct 28 hike to 2.50%; MPR lifts CPI to 3.5% & growth path
hawkish.summary: Hike lifted inflation path to ~3.5% year-end and 3% in 2027, keeping tightening bias open.
hawkish.reason: Consolidates the Oct 28 policy release and MPR growth upgrade: higher-for-longer oil and firmer mid-year demand kept 'there could be a need to increase the policy rate further' active.
hawkish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike fell 0.48->0.34 on release before recovering; implied bias remains live.

hawkish.title: Nov 10 BoC deliberations: pass-through risk rose, hikes open
hawkish.summary: Council warned rising fuel and input costs risk spreading broadly into core inflation.

data.actual: 'the risk that high inflation could persist and become broad-based had increased'

hawkish.reason: Governing Council judged businesses had mostly absorbed higher costs so far, but past experience and surveys pointed to rising pass-through over the next year.

hawkish.title: Oct headline CPI stuck at 3.1% above 1–3% band
hawkish.summary: Gasoline (+30.9% y/y) and grocery gains keep headline inflation above the BoC's 3% cap.
hawkish.reason: Persistent gasoline, natural gas, grocery (+2.0%), and clothing pressures keep headline inflation above the 1-3% control band despite slowing rents.

dovish.title: Q3 SLOS tightens (-6.5 biz / -26.3 mortgage) as GDP stalls
dovish.summary: Lenders tightened credit broadly ahead of October's hike while Aug–Sep GDP tracked ~1.2%.

data.actual: SLOS biz -6.48, mortgage -26.27; Aug GDP 0.0% m/m, Sep advance -0.1% (Q3 ~1.2% ann.)
data.previous: Q2 SLOS biz -1.04, mortgage +0.64; Jul GDP 0.0%

dovish.reason: Consolidates Q3 SLOS tightening and flat Aug / -0.1% Sep GDP tracking (~0.8pp below Oct MPR's 2% Q3 view), reinforcing existing financial restraint before Q3 GDP prints Nov 30.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike eased 0.57->0.51 (-6.0pp) across Nov 20 SLOS release (458 contracts).

dovish.title: Oct LFS: -4.7k jobs, unemployment 6.7%, wages slow to 2.2%
dovish.summary: Flat payrolls, higher joblessness (6.7%), and slower wages reinforce labour-slack pause case.
dovish.reason: Third straight weak employment report pushed unemployment to 6.7% and trimmed wage growth to 2.2%, easing domestic wage-inflation pressure.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike fell 0.365->0.30 (-6.5c) and Polymarket fell 40.5%->30.2% on Nov 6 release.

dovish.title: Core CPI cools: ex-energy 2.0%, CPI-trim 1.8%
dovish.summary: Core ex-energy cooling to 2.0% shows limited second-round energy pass-through so far.
dovish.reason: Core measures remain anchored at or below the 2% target on softer shelter (1.4%) and cell-plan prices, contradicting broad pass-through urgency.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi Dec 25bp-Hike eased 0.485->0.465 (-2.0pp) across Nov 16 release.

dovish.title: Gov. Macklem: 'proceed carefully' as US tariffs hit Q4
dovish.summary: Governor laid out one-meeting-at-a-time approach given core near 2% and tariff Q4 headwinds.

data.actual: 'There could be a need to raise the policy rate further, but given the uncertainties, we will proceed carefully.'

dovish.reason: Macklem explicitly left December conditional on energy spillover and noted new US tariffs will slow Q4 growth while excess supply persists.
dovish.market_validation: Kalshi BoC Dec 25bp fell 0.46->0.34 in 12 minutes after Oct 28 release.
